faq_logTimeReminders_q: Bushe WitnessWork ingamukumbusha ukulemba inshita ya bushiku mwapangile?
faq_logTimeReminders_a: Ee. Yeni pa Ifyo Mwasala → Ubupange, washeni Nkumbushe Ukulemba Inshita, no kusala inshita ya Ukukumbusha Pa (8:00 PM nga tamwacinja). Nga ubushiku bwakwata ubupange lelo tamwalembapo inshita, mukapokelela ukukumbushiwa umuku umo pa nshita ilya, ilyo ubupange bwa bushiku bwapwa: ubupange bwa kumasaka bukamukumbusha ubushiku bumo pa kasuba, kabili ubupange ubucili bulecitwa pa nshita ya Ukukumbusha Pa bukamukumbusha pa bushiku ubukonkapo. Ubupange ubwingi pa bushiku bumo bupela ukukumbusha umo fye, kabili nga ukukumbusha kwa nshiku shibili kwatetekela ukufika pa nshita imo, kukulunganishiwa. Ukulemba inshita iili yonse pa bushiku ubo kulesha ukukumbusha kwabo kabili kufumyapo uko mwapokelela kale; ukufumyapo ubupange bwa bushiku ubo nelyo ukushimya ifyo mwasala nakyo kucita ifyo fine. Ubushiku bwapangwa ukwabula inshita tabumukumbusha, kabili inshiku mwaluba ilyo tamwawashe ifyo mwasala tashingiwamo. Ukutinika pa kukumbusha kwisula Lundapo Inshita ne bushiku, inshita yapangwa, ne musango fyabikwamo kale. Ukukumbusha nakulemwa mu kabelu ka Pa Ntanshi pa mulungu umo, nangu ca kuti ifyakwishibisha fya cibombelo fyashimya. Ifyo mwasala fimoneka ilyo mulelemba inshita; Abakabilisha ba Bufumu bawasha Lemba amaawala yandi pa ntanshi. Ukuwasha kwipusha ukusuminishiwa ukutumiwa ifyakwishibisha, nelyo kwisula ifyo mwasala fya cibombelo nga mwakana kale. Ukukumbusha kupangwa pa cibombelo cenu ukufuma ku bupange bwenu ne nshita yenu, kabili tatumwa kuli konse. Cila cibombelo cipanga ukukumbusha kwa mu mulungu yabili ayakonkapo, ico isuleni WitnessWork nangu mu mulungu yabili umo. Nga mwalemba inshita pa cibombelo cimbi, isuleni WitnessWork pali ici pa kuti ifume ukukumbusha kwa bushiku ubo. Pa Android, icibombelo cingatuma ukukumbusha ukulwa panono pa kupususha amaka ya batri. Nga ukukumbusha tekwisa, moneni ukuti ifyakwishibisha fya WitnessWork fyasuminishiwa mu fyo mwasala fya cibombelo, kabili ukuti Focus nelyo Do Not Disturb tafishimya. Nga cilya cimo, tumeni ubwafya ukufuma pa Pa Kwafwilisha ukwabula ukulemba amashina nelyo ifyebo fimbi ifyasuma.
faq_streaks_a: Ukukonkana kwenu kulanga ifyo mulekonkela ubupange mupanga. Pa bapainiya ne mimulimo imbi iilemba amaawala, cila bushiku bwapangwa ubo mulembako inshita iili yonse bulundako umo, nangu ca kuti mwalemba panono ukucila ifyo mwapangile. Inshiku shatapangwa tashilundako nelyo ukupwisha, ico pangeni inshiku mulefwaya ukuya mu mulimo. Pa bakabilisha, cila mweshi mwabombako mu mulimo wa kushimikila ulundako umo, nangu ca kuti mwalemba pa Pa Ntanshi nelyo mwalemba inshita. Ukukonkana kwenu kumoneka pa mutwe wa Pa Ntanshi na pa Profile yenu ilyo kwafika pa 3. Ilyo ukulemba bushiku kwamutwala ku cipimo, nga 3, 5, nelyo 10, ukusekelela kunono kulalangwa; pa nshiku shimbi, na ilyo ukukula kwaisa mu nshila imbi, nga inshita ilembwa pa wotchi yenu nelyo pa cibombelo cimbi, ilangilo lya mulilo pa Pa Ntanshi lyamoneka bwino. Ilyo kwatetekela ukupwa, tinikeni pa Pa Ntanshi pa kulemba ubushiku bwafika.
faq_streakEnds_q: Ukukonkana kwandi kupwa lilali, kabili ningakubika shani?
faq_streakEnds_a: Ubushiku bwapangwa bwingalembwa ukufika ku mpela ya bushiku ubukonkapo. Nga bwapita ukwabula ukulembwa inshita, ukukonkana kwenu kupwa. Ilyo kwatetekela ukupwa, ilangilo lya mulilo pa Pa Ntanshi lilanga inshita yashala, kabili Ukukumbusha pa Kukonkana kwisa pa 6:00 PM pa bushiku bwa kulekelesha. Pa bakabilisha, umweshi kuti walembwa ukufika ku mpela ya mweshi ukonkapo, kabili ukukumbusha kwisa inshiku shitatu umweshi ushilapwa. Nga tamwengaya mu mulimo pa bushiku bwapangwa, fumyeni ubupange bwa bushiku ubo ilyo ushilafika: tinikeni pa cila bupange pa Ukupanga, tinikeni Na fimbi (•••), kabili Fumyapo → Fumyapo Ubupange Ubu. Pa bupange ubucitwa nakabili, bushiku bumo fye bufumyapo. Ubushiku bushala bwapangwa nga kuli ubupange ubushashala pali bwene. Nga mwayile mu mulimo lelo mwaluba ukulemba, lundeni inshita pa bushiku ubo kabili ukukonkana kwenu kubwelela. Shimyeni Ukukumbusha pa Kukonkana mu Ifyo Mwasala → Ubupange. Bafwaya ifyakwishibisha ifyasuminishiwa pa WitnessWork.
faq_streakBuddies_q: Bushe banyina bandi kuti bamona ukukonkana kwandi?
faq_streakBuddies_a: Ee, ilyo kwafika pa 3, nga mwasuminisha ukumoneka. Banyina benu bamona fye inambala pa kadi yenu mu lyashi lya Buddies yabo, te nshita yenu nelyo amalipoti yenu. Ifyebo ifi fyacingililwa ukufuma ku ntendekelo ukufika ku mpela nga fimbi ifyo mwabila. Pa kuleka ukulanga, isuleni Ifyo Mwasala fya Buddies no kushimya Ukukonkana. Ukukonkana ukwapwile kuleka ukumoneka pa mafoni ya banyina benu nangu ca kuti app yenu tayasuke.
faq_navigationShortcuts_q: Bushe ningabomfya shani ifya kwangu pa kibodi pa iPad?
faq_navigationShortcuts_a: Tantikeni kibodi pa iPad iyakwata iPadOS 26 nelyo iyakonkelepo, elyo mukakate Command ilyo ifintu fya kwenda fimoneka. Amashina yanono ya fya kwangu yamoneka pa mbali ya fipande fya panshi nelyo fya kuma bao. Tinikeni Command ne nambala ilangwa pa kwisula icipande ico; leteni Command pa kufisa amashina. Inambala shikonka inshila ya kwenda iyo mumona, ico mu kutendeka Pa Ntanshi ni Command 1 kabili Abantu ba Kulanshanya ni Command 2. Inambala shimbi shilekanalekana ukulingana na fyo mumona, pamo na Settings mu bao. Funganyeni ifomu nelyo ipepala lyonse lyasuka pa kuti mubomfye ifya kwangu ifi; tafisunga nelyo ukulekelela ifyalembwa. Ukubomfya fye ifya kwangu kwapimwa, te fyo mulemba. Ukwafwa kufwaya app yasuntinwa iyakwata ifya kibodi, kabili tapali pa iPhone na Android. Nga amashina tayaoneke, moneni ukuti kibodi yatantikwa, bwelelani pa kwenda kwa pa ntanshi, no kukusha no kwisula app nakabili. Mulefwaya, kuti mwatinika fye pa fya kwenda. Pa bwafya bumbi, bomfyeni intambo ya Pa Kwafwilisha iya kwafwa mu cinkama no kubika ifyebo fya kulanshanya ukwabula mu malipoti ya bantu bonse.

faq_pointerHover_q: Bushe ningabomfya shani trackpad, mouse, nelyo Apple Pencil pa iPad?
faq_pointerHover_a: Tantikeni trackpad nelyo mouse pa iPad yenu, nelyo mwimike Apple Pencil iyasuminishiwa pa mulu panono pa cilangililo. Ifibatani, imisararo, ne nshiku sha kalenda fimoneka bwino ilyo cipointa cipita pa mulu wafyo. Ilyo cipao ca mbali cicepa ukwisa ku fishibilo fye, ukwimika cipointa pa cishibilo kulanga ishina lyaco; ifibatani fimbi fya cishibilo fye, nga fya mapu na Ifyakwishibisha, nafyo fimoneka amashina. Imikeni pa cipao ca nshiku, pa ncati ya kutwala pa mulu ya Umwaka wa Mulimo, nelyo pa mulongo wa makilomita pa kumona bushiku bwa ico ne mutengo. Pa mapu, imikeni pa cishibilo ca pa mapu pa kumona ishina lya muntu wa kulanshanya, nelyo imikeni pa muntu wa kulanshanya mu lyashi lya mbali lya mapu pa kupeela ishina cishibilo cakwe. Ukutinika kwa bubili (ukutinika na minwe ibili) kwisula ifyo fine fya menu ne mona kuntanshi ifyo mwamona ilyo mwatinika no kukakatila. Umulongo wa ukucinja ubukulu bwa cipao ca mbali ulanga imyampi ku ncende iyo kuti wayako, kabili ukupitisha minwe ibili kutuntula icikope ca muntu wa kulanshanya ilyo mulecicenjeshako. Fyonse filacili mu kutinika: tinikeni, tinikeni no kukakatila, nelyo kokoleni nga lyonse. Ukwimika takucinja ifyalembwa fyenu. Ukubomfya fye cipointa nelyo Pencil kwapimwa, umuku umo fye pa bushiku, takutumwa incende, amashina nelyo imitengo. Pa Android, mouse ilangilila imisararo no kulanga amashina ne mitengo ya ncati, lelo ifishibilo fya pa mapu tafilanga amashina. iPhone taikwata ukwimika. Nga takuli cileshalula, moneni ukuti trackpad, mouse, nelyo Pencil fyatantikwa, elyo mukushe no kwisula app nakabili. Pa bwafya bumbi, bomfyeni intambo ya Pa Kwafwilisha iya kwafwa mu cinkama no kubika ifyebo fya kulanshanya ukwabula mu malipoti ya bantu bonse.
faq_menuBar_q: Bushe ningabomfya shani menu bar pa iPad?
faq_menuBar_a: Pa iPadOS 26 nelyo iyakonkelepo, bomfyeni Windowed Apps nelyo Stage Manager no kukoka panshi ukufuma pa mpela ya mulu pa kumona menu bar. Pa numa ya kupanga, Ifyo Mwasala fya WitnessWork fyisula ifyo mwasala mu app; icipimo ca Settings ica bulesa cisula ifyo mwasala fya cibombelo cenu. Ifailo yisula Lemba Ulutandalilo…, Lundapo Inshita nga ukulemba amaawala kwawashiwa, Lundapo Umuntu wa Kulanshanya, Ubupange Ubupya, ne Ukusunga no Kubwesha. Lungika → Fwaya Umuntu wa Kulanshanya yisula lyashi lya Abantu ba Kulanshanya no kubika ukufwaya. Ukwafwa kwisula Pa Kwafwilisha, Ifyapya, app yenu ya email pa kwafwa mu cinkama, nelyo Mona Ukukusha. Ifya kwangu ifi fibomfya amapepala yaliko kale; ukwisula ifomu tekusunga nelyo ukutuma ifyalembwa fyenu. Mona Ukukusha kumona nga kuli ukukusha kwa app ukwalingana, kabili kubomfya inshila ya ukusuntinya no kwisula nakabili iyaliko nga kuliko. Takwingasuntinya app iyapya iya cibombelo, kabili tapali mu bufumbwe bwa kupanga. Ukwafwa kwa menu bar kufwaya app yasuntinwa iyakwata ifi, kabili tapali pa iPhone na Android. Nga ifintu fyabula, kusheni ukufuma mu stoo ya app no kwisula WitnessWork nakabili. Kuti mwabomfya fye ifyo fine mu app. Pa bwafya bumbi, bomfyeni intambo ya email ya Pa Kwafwilisha iya kwafwa mu cinkama no kubika ifyebo fya kulanshanya ne fya kusunga ukwabula mu malipoti ya bantu bonse.

founderNoteBody:
Muli shani, niine Levi. Natampile ukupanga WitnessWork mu 2023 pa kupwisha amafya ayo nakwete nine umwine ilyo nale piyona. Icatampile fye nge cilangililo icapwe kunchitilwe nge cibombelo capalama capalama, capangilwe pa lwa ushiku ushingi no kushinguluka.

Calimoneka ukukoselesha ukumfwa kuli bamunyinefwe ne bankashi ukufuma mu calo conse abalemonako amaka. Insambililo yandi ya kuti ici cibombelo cikabombesha bwino kuli imwe pa myaka iingi iileisa.

No lutemwo lwa cibumba,
founderNotePostscript: P.S. WitnessWork ni ya bwebwe kuli bonse, kabili lyonse ikabela fi. Aba Supporter bafwa ukuti ibe fi.

1200.c1: Adds backup and restore functionality. Now you can backup your data to the cloud and restore it later, this allows you to transfer your data to another device. You can also transfer it to another platform. Find this new feature in settings.

1201.c1: Updates monthly routine section of home screen to show surrounding months.

1210.c1: Greatly improved accuracy of time displays.
1210.c2: Improved accuracy of time progress bars.
1210.c3: Added helpful hints for actions that may not be immediately noticeable.
1210.c4: Improved quality of life on the maps screen with more relevant information and a quick-add button.

1211.c1: Added more helpful one-time hints when appropriate.

1220.c3: Added Calendar to time reports screen.

1220.c2: Improved import & export screen to be visually clearer.

1230.c1: Added new Annual Overview screen to view your service year progress by month.

1240.c1: Added ability to manually adjust contact pin location on all map views. Simply touch, hold, and drag the pin.
1240.c2: Added small map view to contact details screen and resolved errors for invalid coordinates.

1250.c1: Big update! Added scheduling & plans! 🚀 You can now create one-time plans, recurring plans, and view your month's schedule.
1250.c2: Improved clarity by adding 'toast' notifications for notable app actions.
1250.c3: Updated various sections of time reports screen to have more information and easier navigation.
1250.c4: Resolved minor visual issues and other bugs.

1270.c1: Added Timer! ⏱️ (Stopwatch). You can now start and stop a timer to track your time directly within the app.

1280.c3: Update dependencies and add security updates.

1290.c2: On home screen, resolved overlapping issues that sometimes happen on small screen sizes.

If you have interest in spending a few hours a month testing, your support would be greatly appreciated. Please contact me: levi@leviwilkerson.com. In the future and as expenses allows, a portion of donations will go to QA for their time.
1290.c6: Annual time overview screen now is compressed for better readability.

1291.c1: [ANDROID] Resolved crashes that occurred when editing time.

1300.c1: Add 'Annual Schedule' to Plan Schedule screen for those with an annual goal, allowing you to easily see if you have planned enough time for your entire service year.
1300.c2: Hides 'today' schedule view when the month is in the future because it's not applicable.
1300.c4: If a contact pin was dragged for a contact, navigation will now prioritize the manually adjusted pin over their address. Editing a contact's address will return the address to priority.
1300.c7: Contact pin colors on Contact Details Screen now matches the map screen.
1300.c9: Month and annual total calculations now properly limit your credit time to 55 hours per month. Standard time is not affected by this rule. If you exceed this time using credit, you'll have overage displayed on your month's details screen.
1300.c10: Added time credit support. Existing users will be able to update their old time entries automatically.
1300.c11: Resolved issue with add button overlapping compass on iOS.

1310.c3: Resolve date localization issue that occurred in some regions.

1310.c7: You can now toggle visibility of the home screen sections. Visit Preferences > Home Screen.
1310.c8: The app now is named WitnessWork, formerly 'JW Time' due to legal reasons.

1360.c10: Enhanced follow up topic input - Now supports multiple lines for easier writing of longer topics.

1360.c14: Improves visibility of Map on Contacts Details screen with better zoom levels.

1383.c1: Plans now have a Type. Assign a category to a scheduled plan and your projected totals reflect the right kind of credit.
1383.c2: Projected totals are more accurate. They respect your monthly credit cap and no longer double-count time you've already logged today.
1383.c3: The celebration chime now respects your ring/silent switch.
1383.c4: Your Donations now shows the correct billing period and price for annual and granted supporter subscriptions.
1383.c5: New contacts and address edits now save immediately, even before the map finishes locating them.
1383.c6: The calendar refreshes right away after you add, edit, or remove a plan.
1383.c7: Map pins stay in focus after you tap them.
1383.c8: Smoother scrolling in the Contacts list.

1400.c1: Switching from MyTime? You can now import your contacts and visit history straight from a MyTime backup, with a preview before anything is added, so there's no manual re-entry.
1400.c2: Date format, clock style, and start of the week are now separate from your app language. Set each one in Settings > Date & Time, with an Auto option that follows your region or device.
1400.c3: You can now customize the day thresholds and colors behind contact staleness. Tune them in Settings > Personalization > Color Key.
1400.c4: The map search box keeps focus while you type, so filtering contacts no longer interrupts you.
1400.c5: Locating contacts on the map now shows live progress, and you can skip it midway without losing your place.
1400.c6: Faster, smoother scrolling in the Contacts list, plus quicker home screen widget updates.
1400.c7: Fixed projected totals around time zone changes, enlarged header buttons for easier tapping, and polished countless small details throughout the app.

1411.c1: Icipya: Kumanya Scribe AI. Namikeni ifyebo fyenu fya mulimo wa kushimikila, nangu ifyalembwa ku kuboko nangu ifyafuma mu app imbi, na Scribe AI ikafyalula ku bantu ba kulanshanya na bo, ukutandalila, ne nshita mwabombela pa kuti mubebete ilyo tacisungwa. Kuti mwawamya ifyafumamo mu kulanshanya, kuti mwatampa ukuleta ifyebo ukufuma na pa kutampa app, kabili tamwakalufye credit pa kuleta ifyebo ifyabula ifyasangwa.
1411.c2: Dashboard ipya ya 'Uno Mweshi' pa cilangililo ca ntanshi iyo kuti mwacinja. Ico mwapanga ukufikapo, ifyo cimoneka, no kubutuka kwa bupange fyaba mu makadi ayo kuti mwatantika no kukusha, ilyo Lipoti yenu ya mulimo ikala mu kadi imo iyayanguka. Tinikeni lipoti pa kumona fyonse mu bwipi.
1411.c3: ico mwapanga ukufikapo cila mweshi overrides. bika calekana ico mwapanga ukufikapo pa lwa single mweshi ilyo yenu circumstances cinja, na mona yenu fyapangilwe ama-awala nga yabo own ukwenda pantanshi ring.
1411.c4: ubupange na fimbi than cimo thing pa bushiku. bushiku ubupange pa cimo cine ubushiku nomba lundapo together, cila keeping ya ici own ulupange, na ubupange ico cita te penda ukulo bushiku ni clearly marked.
1411.c5: Easier ukulungika everywhere. ubupange, ifyalembwa fya nshita, na ukulanshanya nomba have ellipsis menu pa lwa lungika na fumyapo, na ubupange ububwekeshapo offer fumyapo choices pa lwa changing cimo ubushiku, kuntanshi inshiku, nelyo whole series.
1411.c6: Malipoti ya mulimo: Ukutuma kwa Hourglass na NW Publisher nabwela, kuti mwasala inshila ya kutuma iya lyonse, kuti mwalungika amashiwi ya lipoti ilyo tamwatuma, kabili mukapoka icakukumbushanya pa mpela ya mweshi. Ifyacitika fya myaka na myaka nomba kuti mwafyicefya nelyo mwalundapo imyaka ya kunuma.
1411.c7: ubupange nomba shows cila day's status pa glance: kuntanshi, kunuma, muli munshila bwino, cileisa, matched, nelyo no ubupange.
1411.c8: Ukuba Uwafwilisha nomba kulakonka Apple ID yenu pa fibombelo fyonse, ifya Scribe AI filabweshiwapo ukulingana ne nshita, kabili icilangililo ca Uwafwilisha calyanguka.
1411.c9: Fixed ifyalembwa fya nshita na ubupange landing pa icilubo bushiku mu inshita zones pa UTC+12 na beyond, lunda icilubo-bushiku inshiku late mu evening west wa UTC. Fixed mapu pins opening icilubo uwa kutandalila panuma swiping card carousel. inshita ukusenda inshita nomba keeps inshita ya kwishibilwa mu ya ici ica cine mweshi na ica cifyalilwa.
1411.c10: Icakwalula ca Credit pa malupange nomba cilipo kuli bonse ababomfya amaawala. Twawamya ubwafya bunono ubwaleleta ukwima ilyo mwafunga icakusala, twabwesha intanda sha fyatemwikwa ne cishibilo ca sambililo lya Baibolo lya uno mweshi, twacinja ku Expo SDK 57, kabili twacefya ubukulu bwa app.

1420.c1: Imipekanishishe ipya iya pa iPad ilanga abantu, amapu na mapange mu mbali ya fiputulwa fyafyo.
1420.c2: Pekanyeni ififulo fya mashina ya bantu: aluleni ukulondana kwa namba ya foni, imeyili na fifulo ifyo mwalenga, fiseni namba ya foni nangu imeyili, kabili futilenipo ififulo ifyo mwalenga ifyabikwa mu busungilo.
1420.c3: Moneni inshita mwalemba ukulingana ne fiputulwa mu mwaka onse wa mulimo, kabili aluleni umupaka wa maawala ya milimo imbi ayapendwa ku mweshi mu fyakusala fya mitundu ya babila imbila nsuma ayasuminisha ifi.
1420.c4: Amalipoti ayatumwa ku Hourglass nomba yalekanya inshita ya kubila imbila nsuma ku maawala ya milimo imbi ayapendwa.
1420.c5: Umwafwilisha wa kalendala nomba alipo na kabili, ne fya kumupekanishisha mu fyakusala fya Mapange.

1430.c1: Inshila ya kucingilila ifyebo iya bakabilisha mu EU, mu UK na mu Switzerland isunga ifyebo fya bene ba ng'anda ukulingana ne fyo ifunde lisuminisha, pamo no kulemba ukusumina kwabo no kufumyapo abantu ba kutandalila abo mushatandalilepo inshita ntali.
1430.c2: Lundapo uwa kutandalila ukufuma pa cishibilo mwabika pa mapu.
1430.c3: Bakabilisha ba Bufumu kuti basala ukulemba amaawala yabo ne cakupimako inshita, ico bapanga ukufikapo mu mweshi (te ca kukakatila) ne cipande ca Ukukula.
1430.c4: Icipande ca Year nomba cilalanga amaawala yonse aya mwaka wa mulimo ku bakabilisha ba misango yonse, nangu tapali ico mwapanga ukufikapo mu mwaka.
1430.c5: Ukupanga ukubwekeshapo pa ntandalilo nomba te ca kukakatila, kabili kuti mwashimya ifyunda fya app mu Preferences.
1430.c6: Twawamya inshiku ishalealuka ku bakabilisha abaikala mu fifulo fya nshita ifya ku kabanga ka kutali.

1440.c1: Ukwenda kwangu na fipao fine fyakwata amashina ifyo kuti mwaluputula. Mapu nomba yaba pa mulu wa Abantu ba Kulanshanya, kabili Settings fili pe shina lya cikope cenu.
1440.c2: Abantu ba Kulanshanya bapangwa bupya pa ifyakonkapo, kabili ulutandalilo lonse lukwata ubushiku bwalo pa mulongo. Lembeni ulutandalilo ukufuma pa menyu ya +, ne fisonto ifya pafupi, no kulundako ifyabula pa kulanshanya.
1440.c3: Ukupanga kwakwata kalenda ya mwaka ne ya mweshi iyo mwingakusha, kabili ubupange kuti bwaba amaawala fye nelyo inshita ya kutendeka no kupwa.
1440.c4: Moneni ifyo mulekula mu mwaka wa mulimo umweshi ku mweshi, kabili mwisekelele ukukonkana ne baji pa nshila.
1440.c5: Ukukonkelela amakilomita, nga mulefwaya, kulemba amalwendo yenu ne mutengo wa mafuta.
1440.c6: Ukukonkapo kuti kwalunganikanya ku kalenda ya WitnessWork fye, nomba na pa Android, uko kuti mwasunga no kulunganikanya na Google Drive.
1440.c7: Ukukumbusha kulemupembela mu mulandu wa ifyakwishibisha mu cifulo ca kubunganina pa Pa Ntanshi.

donate_description: Please do not donate if you are currently not in a financially stable position. Instead, share the app with your brothers and sisters so they can also enjoy it!
donate_faqAnswer1: As a brother in the hall, I consider it a privilege to be able to use my skills to help others in the congregation. Although free to everyone, developing, running, and maintaining this application, unfortunately costs a significant amount of money and time. I view donating as similar to how one might pay for another's gas after going in service with them - it's a loving gesture that goes greatly appreciated.
donate_faq2: What are the donations used for?
donate_faqAnswer2: Your donation helps keeps this app running! There are costs with purchasing real devices as development equipment, paying for location API service fees, build service API fees, app store fees, and opportunity cost of my many hours spent developing this app. Each piece of support is greatly appreciated!
donate_faqAnswer3: Ee — kabili lyonse ikabako iyobweka. Cili icimbo cilembwa pa lwa fwe bonse. Ukwafwilisha kwa kulondolokela; kwafwilisha ukulondolola pa kupanga ne kwingisha ifintu fimo fimo nge ifya kutasha.
donate_faqAnswer4: Tapali calula pa data yenu. Nga monthly subscription yapwa, ifyalingana fye ne supporters fikabwelapo ku ifyatampishe — lipoti, abakulanshanya, ifyebo, ne pa ifyo mwatemwa fyaikala ifyo fili.
donate_faqAnswer5: Monthly supporters bapokelela Supporter badge ne fimbi ifyaicincintishishepo — accent color iya pa lwakwe lelo, ne fimbi fileisa pa nshita. iCloud sync pa data yenu pa fibombelo fyonse e cinene icatungilila supporter cileisa lubilo. Ne fya kupeela one-time tatwafwa kabili, lelo tafipeela Supporter status iiya kuntanshi.

donate_letter:
Dear Brother or Sister,

I am very honored that you have chosen my app to use in the sea of other amazing choices. I started working on this app when I was pioneering - I just couldn't find a clear and concise place to keep my notes. For me, it felt like I would always lose my paper notes and somehow forget my return visits. I knew a lot of other people felt the same way. My goal when creating this app was to focus on high utility but also simplicity. Anyone should be able to use this app, no matter their age or publisher experience. I hope my app has been a useful tool for you and your service to Jehovah. I have spent countless hours developing this app, and I am very happy to see it being used by so many brothers and sisters around the world. If you haven't already, please let others know about WitnessWork - it's a labor of love. Regardless if you choose to donate, I hope you continue to enjoy the app and the future updates.

Thank you,

Levi Wilkerson
donate_letter_ps: P.S. I'm always available to talk about anything - personal questions, app questions, or other concerns. Feel free to reach out to me at my personal email below.

iCloudImagesEnableConfirm_titleAndroid: Mulefwaya ukutuma ifikope ku Google Drive?
iCloudImagesEnableConfirm_description:
Icikope cenu ca profile ne fikope fyonse fya bantu ba kulanshanya ifyo mwalundako fikakopololwa ku iCloud Drive yenu. Fikalunganikanya ku fibombelo fyenu ifimbi kabili fikapendwa mu cifulo cenu ica iCloud. Ifikope fya profile ne fya bantu ba kulanshanya ifyaputulwa e fyatumwa; ifya cine ifyashaputulwa fisala pa cibombelo uko mwafisalila.

Pa kucingilila bwino sana, tulemusuminisha ukuwasha Advanced Data Protection ya iCloud (Settings → [Ishina Lyenu] → iCloud → Advanced Data Protection) pa kuti ifikope fyacingililwe ukufuma ku ntendekelo ukufika ku mpela, kabili ifibombelo fyenu fye fikwata ifisokoshi.
iCloudImagesEnableConfirm_descriptionAnd: Icikope cenu ca profile ne fikope fyonse fya bantu ba kulanshanya ifyo mwalundako fikakopololwa ku Google Drive yenu. Fikalunganikanya ku fibombelo fyenu ifimbi kabili fikapendwa mu cifulo cenu ica Google. Ifikope fya profile ne fya bantu ba kulanshanya ifyaputulwa e fyatumwa; ifya cine ifyashaputulwa fisala pa cibombelo uko mwafisalila.
iCloudImagesDisableConfirm_description: Ukuleka kuleka ukutuma no kusenda pa cibombelo ici. Ifikope ifyatumwa ne fyo fili pa cibombelo fisala apo fili. Pa kufumyapo na fikope ifyatumwa, pa ntanshi lekeni ukulunganikanya ifikope pa fibombelo fyenu ifimbi pa kuti tafitume nakabili ifya cene.

milestoneHero_liquidGlass_description: Imipangile ipya iyakwata umutande wa mapeja uuleelela, amakadi ayamoneka ngo bulungi, ne fipangwa ifyanaka ifileka ulubuuto lumoneke. Nomba cibombelo camoneka bwino pa foni yenu.

notesImport_description: Namikeni ifyebo fya mulimo wa kushimikila nelyo ifyafuma mu app imbi. Scribe AI ilafyalula ku Bantu ba Kulanshanya, Ukutandalila, ne Nshita Mwabombela pa kuti mubebete ilyo tacisungwa.
notesImport_disclosureTitle: Ifyo Scribe AI abelenga ifyebo fyenu
notesImport_disclosureBody: Scribe AI sends yenu ifyebo uku ica butatu-party ululimi model hosted mu inkama-friendly incende panshi zero-ifyebo-retention agreement. ici reads yenu amalembo na keeps nothing afterward. WitnessWork stores no kopolola wa yenu ifyebo pa yesu servers, na nothing ni calundilwa uku yenu ifyasungwa ukufika imwe langulula na shininkisha.
notesImport_inputHint: Namikeni ifyebo fya mulimo wa kushimikila mu nshila iyo mulefwaya pa kuti Scribe AI iteyanye ukumona kuntanshi kwa fyebo ifyo mulefwaya kuleta.
notesImport_reviewNotice: Nothing ni casungwa ukufika imwe approve ukumona kuntanshi.
notesImport_privacySummary: Scribe AI itumina amalembo yenu ukupitila mu OpenRouter ku bakwete ama model ya mano aya ku Western abasuminishiwa ukwabula ukusunga ifyebo (Zero Data Retention), ico tayasungwa. Amalembo yasungwa fye ilyo ukuleta ifyebo kulebomba; ifyalembwa fyenu fisala pa cibombelo cenu. WitnessWork tailishita nelyo ukusabankanya amalembo yenu, kabili tayabomfya ukusambilisha ama model. Ifyalembwa fya mu ndimi ne fikope fyalulwa amalembo pa cibombelo cenu; amaswi ne fikope tafitumwa kuli konse.

faq_iCloudSync_q: Bushe kuti nalunganikanya ifyebo fyandi pa fibombelo?
faq_iCloudSync_a: iCloud Sync ni cibombelo ca Supporter pa iOS. Isuleni Settings → iCloud Sync pa cila cibombelo icisuminishiwa icibomfya iCloud account imo, pa kulunganikanya ifyalembwa fyenu ifya mulimo, abantu ba kulanshanya, intandalilo, ne fyo mwasala. Ifikope fikwata cisonto cekala icitila Lundako ifikope mu kulunganikanya. Nga tapali intaneti, ifyo fili fyatila Cilepembela ukutantika; ifyo mwacinja fyasungwa pa cibombelo kabili fikalunganikanya ilyo mwabwela pa intaneti. Nga icibombelo cingila muli Apple Account imbi, iCloud Sync yashimya uko ifyalembwa shishilabelengwa nelyo ukutumwa, kabili fisala pa cibombelo; washeni ukulunganikanya nakabili pa kusala ifyo mukalunganya na fyebo fya iCloud ya akaunti iyo. Icibombelo ico nacileka ukusabankanya umusango wa Supporter ukufuma ku akaunti yenu iya kale; nga calishitilwe na akaunti ya App Store iya cibombelo ici, bomfyeni Bwesha Ifyo Mwashita. Icibombelo icapangwa ukufuma ku backup ya cibombelo cimbi cilalunganikanya nge cibombelo cene bwangu. Calendar Sync ni cibombelo ca bwebwe ica kuti kekala icitumina Ukukonkapo kwenu ukwisa ku kalenda yeka; tacilunganikanya ifyalembwa fya app pa fibombelo. Pa Android, aba Supporter balalunganikanya pa mafoni na ma tablet aya Android na Google Drive Sync (moneni “Bushe ningalunganikanya shani ifyebo fyandi pa fibombelo fya Android?”). Ukulunganikanya pakati ka iPhone na cibombelo ca Android tekusuminishiwa; bomfyeni Settings → Ukusunga no Kubwesha pa kusendamo backup.
faq_googleDriveSync_q: Bushe ningalunganikanya shani ifyebo fyandi pa fibombelo fya Android?
faq_googleDriveSync_a: Google Drive Sync ni cibombelo ca Supporter pa Android, mu beta. Pa cila foni nelyo tablet iya Android, isuleni Settings → Google Drive Sync no kuwasha Lunganikanya na Google Drive, elyo musale Google Account imo mu cipao ca Google no kusuminisha WitnessWork ukusunga ifyebo fyayo muli Google Drive yenu. Ilunganikanya ifyalembwa fyenu ifya mulimo, ubupange, abantu ba kulanshanya, intandalilo, amacipande, amakilomita, profile, ne fyo mwasala ifya kusabankanya; ifikope fikwata cisonto cekala icitila Lundako ifikope mu kulunganikanya. Cila cibombelo cikwata cisonto cacene, kabili ifyo mwasala nga data protection mode, ukusuminisha analytics, na onboarding fisala pa cila cibombelo. Ilyo WitnessWork yaisuka, ifyo mwacinja pa fibombelo fyenu ifimbi fifika mu miniti iyalingana imo, kabili ifintu fimbi ilyo mwaisula nakabili; tinikeni Lunganikanya nomba pa kumona bwangu. Pa cibombelo cipya ica Android, salenipo Ukufuma ku Google Drive pa cipao ca kupanga ica “Tendekeni uko mwaleka”, pa kubwesha ifyebo fyenu, ico cileta na umusango wenu wa Supporter ilyo Google Account iyo yatantikwa. Nga icibombelo citantika Google Account imbi, ukulunganikanya kushimya uko ifyalembwa shishilabelengwa nelyo ukutumwa, kabili ifyalembwa fyenu fisala pa cibombelo. Ukulunganikanya pakati ka iPhone na cibombelo ca Android tekusuminishiwa; bomfyeni Settings → Ukusunga no Kubwesha pa kusendamo backup.
faq_googleDriveSyncPrivacy_q: Bushe Google Drive Sync isunga finshi, kabili ni nani wingaimona?
faq_googleDriveSyncPrivacy_a: Cila cibombelo ca Android cisunga icikope cimo ica fyebo fya WitnessWork, pamo ne fikope (nga mwafisala), mu folda iyafisama ya app muli Google Drive ya akaunti iyo mwatantika. WitnessWork fye ingaisula folda iyo: tamoneka mu app nelyo pa webusayiti ya Drive, ama app yambi tayingaibelenga, kabili WitnessWork tayingamona ifintu fimbi muli Drive yenu. Ifyebo fyenu fiya fye pakati ka cibombelo cenu na Google kabili tafipita mu maseva ya WitnessWork. Google ifisunga mu Google Account yenu nge failo shimbi sha Drive; tafyacingililwa ukufuma ku ntendekelo ukufika ku mpela. WitnessWork isunga fye code iyakatemwa iya akaunti iyatantikwa pa cibombelo, te email yenu. Folda ipendwa mu cifulo cenu ica Google. Pa kuifumyapo, shimyeni ukulunganikanya pa fibombelo fyonse, elyo mu Google Drive pa web isuleni Settings → Manage apps → WitnessWork → Options → Delete hidden app data. Ukufumya Google Drive mu Settings → Google Drive Sync kuleka ukufika ukufuma pa cibombelo ico kabili kusha folda ku fibombelo fyenu ifimbi. Pa kufumyapo ukufika kwa WitnessWork pa fibombelo fyonse, ifumyeni mu Third-party apps & services mu Google Account yenu. Amabackup yenu aya JSON aya mu Settings → Ukusunga no Kubwesha yalekana kabili yasala uko mwayasunga.
faq_googleDriveSyncTroubleshooting_q: Google Drive Sync tailebomba pa cibombelo candi ica Android. Finshi ningamona?
faq_googleDriveSyncTroubleshooting_a: Isuleni Settings → Google Drive Sync no kubelenga ifyo ilanga. Moneni ukuti cila cibombelo catantikwa ku Google Account imo kabili ukuti Google Play services yasuntinwa kabili yakushiwa. Nga ilanga ukuti mutantike nakabili, tinikeni Tantika Google Drive nakabili no kusuminisha ukufika nakabili; Google ipusha nakabili nga ukufika kwafumyapo mu fyo mwasala fya Google Account. Nga icifulo cenu ica Google cisulile, ifyo mwacinja fisala pa cibombelo ici ukufika kwabako incende; fumyeni ifintu nelyo mushite icifulo cingi, elyo mutinike Lunganikanya nomba. Ukulunganikanya kufwaya intaneti; ilanga Cilepembela ukutantika ukufika ilyo mwabwelela pa intaneti, kabili ifyo mwacinja ilyo tamuli pa intaneti fitumwa ilyo WitnessWork yaisuka. Nga ilanga ukuti Google Drive ilebomba sana, Google ilekanya ukupempa inshita; ifyo mwacinja fisala pa cibombelo ici kabili ukulunganikanya kwesha nakabili ukwabula imwe. Nga icibombelo cibomfya version ipya iya WitnessWork, kusheni ifibombelo fyonse. Google Drive Sync ifwaya ukufika kwa Supporter; nga kwapwa, ukulunganikanya kuleka kabili kutendeka nakabili ilyo ukufika kwabwela. Sungeni backup yatumwa na cibombelo cikwata ifyebo fyenu ifya kulekelesha ilyo mushilapanga nakabili ifyebo fya Google Drive. Lembeleni ukwafwa kwa cinkama ukufuma pa Pa Kwafwilisha nga ukulunganikanya kucili kulesha, kabili ubeni ifyebo fya bene ng'anda ukwabula mu malipoti ya bantu bonse.
faq_calendarSetup_q: Bushe ningalanga shani Ukukonkapo mu kalenda yandi?
faq_calendarSetup_a: Calendar Sync ni ya bwebwe pa iPhone, iPad, na Android. Ubu bwasuko bwaba pa iPhone na iPad, kabili Bushe Calendar Sync ibomba shani pa Android? bwaba pa Android. Ilyo mulepanga pa ntanshi, nelyo ukufuma ku kwita mu cipao ca fyakwishibisha panuma ya kukusha, tinikeni Lundapo ku Kalenda pa kupanga kalenda ya WitnessWork (muli iCloud nga yaliko). Kuti mwapanga inshita iili yonse mu Settings → Ifyo Mwasala → Calendar Sync: suminisheni ukufika kwa kalenda yonse, elyo mupange kalenda ya WitnessWork nelyo musale kalenda ibomfiwa fye pa WitnessWork. Ukukusha kufwaya ukwingila muli iCloud na intaneti, nangu pa makalenda ya Google nelyo Outlook. Pa kubomfya Google nelyo Outlook, pangeni kalenda ku mupeele wa ico, lundeni akaunti mu iPhone Settings → Apps → Calendar → Calendar Accounts, no kuwasha amakalenda yaco. Kalenda yenu ya bulesa na makalenda ya sungwa fye pa cibombelo ici tayingasalwa. Ilyo kalenda yasalwa, cila Ukukonkapo ukwisa kulundwako bwangu, pamo na uko mwasunga kale, nge ciputulwa ca miniti 30. Calendar Sync ilundako Ukukonkapo konse ukwisa nelyo ukwabula; pa kuleka ukulundako, ishimyeni mu Settings → Ifyo Mwasala → Calendar Sync. Ukukonkapo kwapita, Ubupange bwa mulimo, ne Bupange ubucitwa nakabili tafilundwako. Cila ciputulwa cipokelela ukukumbusha kumo ne kwa Nkumbushe pa Kukonkapo kwaco, kabili tapali ukukumbusha nga Nkumbushe yashimiwa. Umupeele wa kalenda yenu kuti alundako ukukumbusha kwakwe; pa Google, ukufumyapo mu Event notifications ya kalenda iyo mu fyo mwasala fya Google Calendar. Cinjeni mu WitnessWork, pantu ifyo mwacinja mu kalenda, pamo na ukukumbusha, fingacinjiwa pa kukusha ukukonkapo.
faq_calendarPrivacy_q: Bushe Calendar Sync isabankanya nelyo isunga finshi?
faq_calendarPrivacy_a: Mu kutendeka, ifiputulwa ifyatumwa fikwata umutwe wa Ukukonkapo wa bulesa, inshita ne nshita iyo cimbila, ne link iyisula Ulutandalilo muli WitnessWork. Lundako amashina na adiresi te kukakatila kabili cibomba pa fibombelo fyonse; ukuwasha kulundako ifyebo ifyo ku fiputulwa. Amalembo ya ntandalilo ne fyalanshanya fya Ukukonkapo tafitumwa. Umupeele wa kalenda yenu kuti alunganikanya ifiputulwa ku fibombelo fimbi, amakalenda yasabankanishiwa, ne widgets, ico moneni ifyo mwasala fya kusabankanya fya kalenda iyo ilyo mushilalundako ifyebo. WitnessWork ilolesha fye ifiputulwa ifyo yalembamo ukuti fyayo kabili tayiletako ifyo mwapanga mu kalenda yenu ya cene. Icalembwa ca iCloud icacingililwa cisunga amashina ya fibombelo ne fishibilo fyabula ukwishibikwa, ukwikala kwa kutumina, ishina lya kalenda iyatantikwa ne cishibilo ca akaunti, ifyo mwasala ifya kusabankanya, ne fishibilo fya fiputulwa. Ifyebo fya ciputulwa fisala muli akaunti ya kalenda iyo mwasala. Icishibilo ca kalenda ca cila cibombelo ne cifulo ca kutantika fisala pa cibombelo kabili fyalekana na fyebo fya app ifya kulunganikanya na failo sha kusunga.
faq_calendarPrimary_q: Cinshi Calendar Sync ibomfya cibombelo ca ntanshi?
faq_calendarPrimary_a: Icibombelo cimo fye citumina Ukukonkapo kwenu pa kuti tapabe ukupilibula. Icibombelo ica ntanshi ukutantika cabe ca ntanshi. Pa fibombelo fya iOS ifibomfya iCloud account imo, isuleni Settings → Ifyo Mwasala → Calendar Sync pa kulemba cila cibombelo, ukumona lyashi lya Icibombelo ca ntanshi, no kusala ica ntanshi. Calendar Sync yene tayifwaya Supporter. Ukukonkapo ukwacinjiwa pa cibombelo cimbi kufika ku ca ntanshi ukupitila mu kulunganikanya kwa fyebo fya app, uko kucili kufwaya Supporter na iCloud Sync iyawashiwa; isuleni WitnessWork pa ca ntanshi pa kutumina. Panuma ya kusenda, icibombelo ca ntanshi cipya cifwaya ukufika kuli akaunti imo iya kalenda no kusuminishiwa ukwa kalenda yonse. Nga ukusenda kulepembela, isuleni WitnessWork nakabili pa cibombelo ca ntanshi icapita pa kuti cipwishe icintu cakwe. Tapali ukupoka kwa bwangu nga icibombelo ico tacingabwelela nakabili; bomfyeni ukwafwa kwa cinkama pa Still need help? mu Pa Kwafwilisha. Ukufumyapo icibombelo icakale mu lyashi tekufumyapo ifyalembwa fya app nelyo ifiputulwa fya kalenda.
faq_calendarTroubleshooting_q: Ifiputulwa fya kalenda fyabula nelyo ukukusha kwaleka. Nshi ningacita?
faq_calendarTroubleshooting_a: Nga Calendar Sync yaleka ukukusha, icishibisho ca Ukukusha kwa kalenda kwaleka cimoneka mu cipao ca fyakwishibisha (belu pa Pa Ntanshi): bwangu nga pali icintu icifwaya imwe, nga ukufika kwa kalenda, nelyo panuma ya bushiku bumo pa bwafya ubwingi ubwapwa bwene, nga ukubula intaneti. Tinikeni pa kumona ifyo mwacita, nelyo musale Shimya nga mushilefwaya Ukukonkapo mu kalenda yenu. Kuti mwaisula na Settings → Ifyo Mwasala → Calendar Sync no kubelenga ubwafya ubulanga. Moneni ukutantika kwenu ku intaneti, ukwingila muli iCloud, akaunti ya kalenda, ne kufika kwa kalenda yonse kwa WitnessWork mu iPhone Settings. Bomfyeni Lunganikanya nomba pa cibombelo ca ntanshi panuma ya akaunti yenu ya kalenda ne fyebo fya app ukupwisha ukulunganikanya. Kalenda iyabula ifwile ukutantikwa nakabili nelyo ukucinjiwa; amakalenda yacinjiwa ishina kunse ya WitnessWork kuti yafwaya ukusalwa nakabili. Ilyo ciputulwa ca kuntanshi icatumwa kale cabula, ukukusha kuleka nangu ca kuti icibombelo ici cacitumina: ukucelwa kwa kalenda, ukufumyapo, no kusendeshako ciputulwa fingaba fimo. Pembeleni akaunti ya kalenda ukupwisha ukulunganikanya no kushininkisha ukuti mwasala kalenda imo iyapangilwa. Bwesheni ifiputulwa fya WitnessWork ifyo mwasenda kumbi pa ntanshi ya kwesha nakabili. Bwesha ifiputulwa ifyabula ni nshila ya kubwesha iyasalwa panuma ya ifi fya kumona; kuti yapanga ifyapilibulwa nga ifya kopololwa fichili fileisa nelyo fisala kumbi. Ukukonkapo kwapita tekulundwako pa ntanshi. Pa kusenda kwa cibombelo kulepembela, isuleni nakabili icibombelo ca ntanshi icapita. Nga ubwafya bucili bulefikilila, bomfyeni ukwafwa kwa cinkama ukwa Pa Kwafwilisha no kulundako version ya app, icibombelo ne version ya operating system, ne bwafya bulangwa. Eka ifyebo fya bantu ba kulanshanya, ifikope fya kalenda, amalembo, na ma backup ukwabula mu malipoti ya bantu bonse.
faq_calendarDisconnect_q: Nshi cicitika ilyo nashimya Calendar Sync nelyo nafumya WitnessWork?
faq_calendarDisconnect_a: Mu Settings → Ifyo Mwasala → Calendar Sync, salenipo Shimya Calendar Sync, nelyo Shimya pa cishibisho ca Ukukusha kwa kalenda kwaleka. Pa cibombelo ca ntanshi, icilekusha kalenda yenu, kuti mwasunga ifiputulwa ifyalundwako kale nelyo ukufifumyapo. Fumyapo Ifiputulwa kufumyapo ifiputulwa ifyalembwa ukufuma pa kalenda iyasalwa, pamo ne fyapita ifyatumwa; ifiputulwa ifyashikwatanako na kalenda yene fisala. Ukushimya pa cibombelo ca ntanshi kuleka ukukusha ukufuma pa fibombelo fyonse. Pa cibombelo cimbi conse, Calendar Sync yashimya pa cibombelo ico fye kabili ifiputulwa fisala. Ifiputulwa ifyo musunga, nelyo ifyashala panuma ya kufumya app, tafikushiwa nakabili ukufika mwapanga Calendar Sync nakabili. Ukufumya WitnessWork tekufumyapo ifiputulwa fya kalenda. Kuti mwafumyapo kalenda iyapangilwa iyatabomfiwa mu app yenu ya kalenda panuma ya kumona ukuti tapali icintu mulefwaya ukusunga. Ukushimya Calendar Sync tekufumyapo Abantu benu ba Kulanshanya, Intandalilo, nelyo Ukukonkapo muli WitnessWork.
faq_calendarAndroid_q: Bushe Calendar Sync ibomba shani pa Android?
faq_calendarAndroid_a: Calendar Sync ni ya bwebwe pa Android. Ilyo mulepanga pa ntanshi, ukufuma ku kwita mu cipao ca fyakwishibisha, nelyo mu Settings → Ifyo Mwasala → Calendar Sync, tinikeni Lundapo ku Kalenda nelyo Sala kalenda, elyo musuminishe ukufika kwa kalenda. Pangeni kalenda ya WitnessWork pa cibombelo ici, nelyo musale kalenda iliko iyabomfiwa fye pa WitnessWork, nge iyo mwapanga muli Google Calendar no kuyibika ukulunganikanya na foni iyi. Kalenda iyapangwa pa cibombelo isala pa cibombelo ici; kalenda ya Google nayo imoneka pa fibombelo fyenu ifimbi na pa web. Amakalenda ya ntanshi tayingasalwa. Cila Ukukonkapo ukwisa kulundwako nge ciputulwa ca miniti 30 ne kukumbusha kumo ne kwa Nkumbushe yaco; Calendar Sync ilundako Ukukonkapo konse ukwisa nelyo ukwabula. Ukukonkapo kwapita ne Bupange tafilundwako. Ukukusha kubomba ilyo mwaisula WitnessWork na panuma ya kusunga ifyo mwacinja, kabili Lunganikanya nomba ikusha bwangu. Ifyebo fya cila ciputulwa fikwata link ya WitnessWork iyishibisha Ukukonkapo kwaco, ico ukukusha kucinja ciputulwa ico fye mu cifulo ca kulundako cimbi, nangu ca kuti cibombelo cimbi ica Android cikusha kalenda imo ya Google. Mwatacinja link iyo. Ciputulwa ico mwafumyapo mu app yenu ya kalenda cibwela pa kukusha ukukonkapo. Android taikwata cibombelo ca ntanshi kabili tayibomfya iCloud, kabili Lundako amashina na adiresi ibomba pa cibombelo ici fye. Nga ukukusha kwaleka, nga ukufika kwa kalenda kwashimiwa, icishibisho ca Ukukusha kwa kalenda kwaleka cimoneka mu cipao ca fyakwishibisha; tinikeni pa kumona ifyo mwacita, nelyo musule Calendar Sync pa kubelenga ubwafya, elyo mubomfye Isula Settings nelyo Lunganikanya nomba. Shimya Calendar Sync isunga nelyo ifumyapo ifiputulwa fya WitnessWork; tayifumyapo kalenda nelyo ifiputulwa fyenu ifimbi. Ukufumya WitnessWork kusha ifiputulwa fyaco, ico mwafifumyeko pa ntanshi nga mushafwaya. Nga ubwafya bucili bulefikilila, bomfyeni ukwafwa kwa cinkama ukwa pa Still need help? mu Pa Kwafwilisha, kabili eka ifyebo fya bantu ba kulanshanya ne fikope fya kalenda ukwabula mu malipoti ya bantu bonse.
faq_widgets_q: ni uko intendekelo nelyo lock icilangililo widgets?
faq_widgets_a: ee, pa iOS. citali-tinikeni yenu intendekelo nelyo lock icilangililo, tinikeni + ibotoni, fwaya pa lwa WitnessWork, na sala widget imwe fwaya. ama-awala widget shows yenu cila mweshi ukwenda pantanshi pa glance.
faq_appleWatch_q: Bushe kuli app ya Apple Watch?
faq_appleWatch_a: Ee, pa iPhone iyakwata Apple Watch pa watchOS 26 nelyo iyakonkelepo. Ilingila yeka nga Automatic App Install yawashiwa; nga te ifyo, isuleni app ya Watch pa iPhone yenu, mufwaye WitnessWork pa Available Apps, no kutinika Install. Elyo mwisule WitnessWork pa iPhone yenu umuku umo pa kuti wotchi yenu ipokelele ifyo mwakula. Pa wotchi kuti mwalundako inshita ya lelo na Musango te kukakatila, mwatendeka no kuleka icakupimako inshita ica pa iPhone yenu, no kusunga inshita ya cakupimako nge cisanshi. Nga tamulemba amaawala nga Kabilisha wa Bufumu, kuti mwabika icishibilo ca kuti mwashimikila amakuku yawama uno mweshi. Ifishibilo fibili kuti fyaikalwa pa wotchi nelyo pa Smart Stack: Monthly Progress ilanga amaawala yenu ku co mwapanga ica mweshi uno, ne cishibilo uko ubupange bwenu bwamutwala ilelo; mu ncende iyakulungatana kuti mwasala ncingo nelyo cipimo, ne co mwapanga pa mpela nelyo ne wotchi panshi, kabili nga tapali co mwapanga ilanga fye amaawala yenu. Up Next ilanga Ukukonkapo kwenu ukukonkapo nelyo ubupange. Kuti mwabomfya na Siri pa wotchi yenu pa kulundako inshita, ukutendeka, ukuleka nelyo ukupwisha icakupimako inshita, no kulemba ulwendo lwa makilomita, na mashiwi yamo ayo ya pa iPhone, nga “Lundeni inshita muli WitnessWork” nelyo “Lembeni ulwendo muli WitnessWork”. iPhone yenu isunga ifyalembwa fyenu. Wotchi ipokelela ukukula kwenu kwa mweshi, ifyo lipoti yaba, icakupimako inshita, Imisango, amashina ya motoka ne cipimo ca ndambo, kabili pa Up Next ishina, adiresi ne ilyashi lya Ukukonkapo kwenu ne mutwe ne ncende sha bupange bwa mu mulungu yabili ishikonkapo. Tayipokelela amalembo nelyo ifyebo fimbi ifya muntu wa kulanshanya, kabili tayingacinja nelyo ukufumyapo ifyalembwa. App ya wotchi ifwaya iPhone yenu, ico tayaba pa Apple Watch iyapangwa na Family Setup. Pa foni ya Android, bomfyeni app ya Wear OS.
faq_appleWatchUpNext_q: Bushe Up Next pa Apple Watch yandi ilanga finshi?
faq_appleWatchUpNext_a: Up Next ilanga icitendeka pa ntanshi: Ukukonkapo kwenu ukukonkapo nelyo ubupange bwenu ubukonkapo. Ubupange bumoneka fye nga mulemba amaawala. Lundeni cishibilo ca Up Next pa wotchi nelyo pa Smart Stack: tinikeni no kukakatila pa wotchi yenu no kutinika Edit, nelyo mubomfye app ya Watch pa iPhone yenu. Nayo ili pa cilangililo ca pa ntanshi ica app ya wotchi. Ukukonkapo nelyo ubupange bumoneka pa miniti 15 panuma ya kutendeka, ico kuti mwamona adiresi nelyo ilyashi ilyo mwafika, elyo ica kukonkapo cimoneka. Ubupange ubutakwata nshita ya kutendeka bumoneka bushiku bonse, panuma ya fintu fya bushiku ubo ifikwata inshita. Ukukonkapo kwaluba tekumoneka; kusanga muli WitnessWork pa iPhone yenu. Amashina ne nshyashi fifisiwa ilyo icikasa cenu cili panshi nelyo wotchi yafungwa, pantu abantu bambi kuti bamona wotchi yenu. Tinikeni Up Next pa kuisula, elyo mutinike Directions pa kupokelela inshila mu Maps pa wotchi yenu, nelyo Start Timer pa kutendeka icakupimako inshita ica pa iPhone yenu ica bupange; icakupimako cifwaya iPhone yenu ukuba pafupi. Up Next ilolesha mu mulungu yabili ishikonkapo kabili iyabombela ilyo iPhone yenu yaba kutali. Ifyo mwacinja pa iPhone yenu fisendwa ku wotchi ilyo fikatantika inshita imbi. Nga yabula ukukushiwa, isuleni WitnessWork pa iPhone yenu, elyo pa wotchi yenu. Pa bwafya bumbi, bomfyeni intambo ya Pa Kwafwilisha iya kwafwa mu cinkama kabili ubeni ifyebo fya bene ng'anda ukwabula mu malipoti ya bantu bonse.
faq_siri_q: Bushe kuti nabomfya Siri nelyo Shortcuts na WitnessWork?
faq_siri_a: Ee, pa iPhone na iPad iyakwata iOS 17 nelyo iyakonkelepo, na pa app ya Apple Watch. Isuleni WitnessWork umuku umo panuma ya kukusha, elyo mulande “Lundeni inshita muli WitnessWork” (nelyo “Lembeni inshita muli WitnessWork”), “Tendekeni icakupimako candi muli WitnessWork”, “Lekeni icakupimako candi muli WitnessWork”, “Pwisheni icakupimako candi muli WitnessWork”, “Lembeni ulwendo muli WitnessWork” nelyo “Lembeni ulwendo lwa kuya no kubwela muli WitnessWork”. Siri isheeka mu lulimi lwenu lwa Siri, ulwingalekana ne lulimi lwa mwasala muli WitnessWork. Siri ipusha inshita shinga nelyo ukuya kutali shinga. Ukuya kutali kubomfya cipimo cenu ca ndambo mu Mileage; pa lwendo lwa kuya no kubwela, landeni ndambo ya kuya fye kabili yalundwa kabili. Ukupwisha icakupimako inshita kulundako amineti yonse yaco nge cisanshi ca lelo no kucibika pa busana; nga ili panshi ya miniti imo, tapali icalundwako. Inshita ne ndwendo shilundwako ku lelo, nge nshita ya bulesa na motoka iyo mwabomfya pa kulekelesha. Pa kusala Umusango nelyo motoka, lundeni icintu mu app ya Shortcuts, uko kuti mwacitendeka na Action Button nelyo shortcut ya pa Home Screen. Ukulundako inshita ne cakupimako inshita fifwaya ukuti mulemba amaawala (Bakabilisha ba Bufumu bawasha Lemba amaawala yandi pa ntanshi). Ukulemba ndwendo kufwaya Track Mileage ukuwashiwa na motoka imo ukulubulwa. Pa iPhone na iPad icakupimako cinjila bwangu, kabili inshita ne ndwendo ishalundwako na Siri shisungwa ilyo mwaisula WitnessWork nakabili, elyo fyaya ku fibombelo fyenu ifimbi na iCloud Sync nge fisanshi fimbi. Pa wotchi fitumwa ku iPhone yenu nge fisanshi fimbi fya wotchi. Siri ibomfya fye Imisango yenu, amashina ya motoka, cipimo ca ndambo na cakupimako inshita ukufuma muli WitnessWork, tayibomfya abantu ba kulanshanya, amalembo nelyo amalipoti. Siri na Shortcuts tayaba pa Android. Nga Siri taileishiba ilyashi, isuleni WitnessWork umuku umo, pembeleni miniti, elyo mumone nga Siri yasuminishiwa pa WitnessWork mu Settings. Pa bwafya bumbi, bomfyeni intambo ya Pa Kwafwilisha iya kwafwa mu cinkama kabili ubeni ifyalembwa fyenu ukwabula mu malipoti ya bantu bonse.
faq_appleWatchSync_q: Cinshi Apple Watch yandi ilanda ukuti Syncing with iPhone?
faq_appleWatchSync_a: Inshita ne ndwendo ishalundwa pa wotchi yenu shitumwa ku iPhone yenu bwangu nga ili pafupi, nelyo ilyo shikatantika inshita imbi, kabili shisungwa ilyo WitnessWork yabomba pa iPhone yenu. Ukufika kuli ilya nshita, wotchi yenu ilanga Syncing with iPhone. Ubunga bwayo ne fishibilo fyayo fikwata inshita iyo bwangu, kano Inshita ya Credit, iyalundwako ilyo iPhone yenu iyisunga no kubomfya umupaka wenu wa credit wa mweshi. Cila cisanshi cisunga ubushiku mwacilundako pa wotchi, cisungwa umuku umo fye nangu catumwa nakabili, kabili tacibwesha nga mwacifumyapo kale pa iPhone yenu. Ifisanshi ifyasungwa fyaya ku fibombelo fyenu ifimbi na iCloud Sync nge fisanshi fimbi. Ukutendeka, ukuleka, ukupwisha ne kusunga icakupimako inshita fifwaya iPhone yenu ukuba pafupi. Nga wotchi ilanda ukuti icakupimako cacinja pa iPhone yenu, moneni inshita elyo mwesheko nakabili. Nga wotchi yenu yacili yabula ukukushiwa, ikeni iPhone yenu pafupi kabili yasuluka, isuleni WitnessWork pa iPhone yenu, elyo pa wotchi yenu. Panuma ya kuti iPhone yenu yatendeka nakabili, isuluseni umuku umo pa ntanshi ya kulunganikanya. Pa bwafya bumbi, bomfyeni intambo ya Pa Kwafwilisha iya kwafwa mu cinkama kabili ubeni ifyalembwa fyenu ukwabula mu malipoti ya bantu bonse.
faq_wearOs_q: Bushe kuli app ya Wear OS?
faq_wearOs_a: Ee, pa foni ya Android iyakwata wotchi pa Wear OS 3 nelyo iyakonkelepo. Suntineni WitnessWork ukufuma pa Play Store pa wotchi yenu, nelyo ukufuma pa lupapa lwa WitnessWork pa Play Store pa foni yenu, elyo mwisule WitnessWork pa foni yenu umuku umo pa kuti wotchi yenu ipokelele ifyo mwakula. Pa wotchi kuti mwalundako inshita ya lelo na Musango te kukakatila, mwatendeka no kuleka icakupimako inshita ica pa foni yenu, no kusunga inshita ya cakupimako nge cisanshi. Nga tamulemba amaawala nga Kabilisha wa Bufumu, kuti mwabika icishibilo ca kuti mwashimikila amakuku yawama uno mweshi. Lundeni ifishibilo fya Monthly Progress na Up Next pa wotchi, na tile ya Monthly Progress pa kutendeka nelyo ukuleka icakupimako inshita nelyo ukulundako inshita ukupitisha. Ilyo icakupimako cilebomba, cimoneka pa wotchi yenu na Pause na Stop; Stop ilundako amineti yonse ya cakupimako nge cisanshi ca lelo. Suminisheni ifyakwishibisha ilyo wotchi yenu yapempa, pa kuti icakupimako icilebomba cimoneke uko. Foni yenu isunga ifyalembwa fyenu. Wotchi ipokelela ukukula kwenu kwa mweshi, ifyo lipoti yaba, icakupimako inshita, Imisango, amashina ya motoka ne cipimo ca ndambo, kabili pa Up Next ishina, adiresi ne ilyashi lya Ukukonkapo kwenu ne mutwe ne ncende sha bupange bwa mu mulungu yabili ishikonkapo. Tayipokelela amalembo nelyo ifyebo fimbi ifya muntu wa kulanshanya, kabili tayingacinja nelyo ukufumyapo ifyalembwa. Pantu abantu bambi kuti bamona wotchi yenu, Up Next ilanga “Ukukonkapo” mu cifulo ca shina pa wotchi, na mu app ilyo icikasa cenu cili panshi; isuleni pa kumona ni nani. Wear OS tayingalundako inshita nelyo ukulemba ndwendo ku mashiwi, ico bomfyeni tile nelyo app. App ya wotchi ifwaya foni yenu iyakwata WitnessWork.
faq_wearOsSync_q: Cinshi wotchi yandi ya Wear OS ilanda ukuti Syncing with phone?
faq_wearOsSync_a: Inshita mulundako pa wotchi yenu itumwa ku foni yenu bwangu nga ili pafupi, nelyo ilyo ikatantika inshita imbi, kabili isungwa ilyo mwaisula WitnessWork pa foni yenu nakabili. Ukufika kuli ilya nshita, wotchi yenu ilanga Syncing with phone. Ubunga bwayo, tile ne fishibilo fikwata inshita iyo bwangu, kano Inshita ya Credit, iyalundwako ilyo foni yenu iyisunga no kubomfya umupaka wenu wa credit wa mweshi. Cila cisanshi cisunga ubushiku mwacilundako pa wotchi, cisungwa umuku umo fye nangu catumwa nakabili, kabili tacibwesha nga mwacifumyapo kale pa foni yenu. Ukutendeka, ukuleka, ukupwisha ne kusunga icakupimako inshita fifwaya foni yenu ukuba pafupi, nangu WitnessWork taiisulwa pali yene. Nga wotchi ilanda ukuti icakupimako cacinja pa foni yenu, moneni inshita elyo mwesheko nakabili. Nga wotchi yenu yacili yabula ukukushiwa, moneni ukuti yatantikwa ku foni yenu mu app ya wotchi, ikeni foni yenu pafupi, isuleni WitnessWork pa foni yenu, elyo pa wotchi yenu. Pa bwafya bumbi, bomfyeni intambo ya Pa Kwafwilisha iya kwafwa mu cinkama kabili ubeni ifyalembwa fyenu ukwabula mu malipoti ya bantu bonse.
faq_switchingPioneer_q: Bushe ningacinja shani ukufuma pali Kasabankanya ukuya kuli Painia wa Kwafwilisha pakati ka mweshi?
faq_switchingPioneer_a: Isuleni Ifyo Mwasala → Umusango wa Kasabankanya no kusala ico calinga nomba: Kasabankanya, Painia wa Kwafwilisha, Painia wa Nshita Yonse, Painia Waibela, Kangalila wa Muputule, nelyo Custom. Ifyo mwapanga ukufikapo ne fyonse pamo fikacinja ukulingana na co. Bwelelapo ilyo mwapwisha. Imyeshi yapita ilasunga inshita iyo mwalembele, e ico ifyacitika fyenu fikaba fya cine.
faq_submitReport_q: Bushe app ilatuma lipoti yandi ya mulimo?
faq_submitReport_a: WitnessWork tailetumina lipoti yenu kuli konse yeka. Ifyo mutuma no kutuma kuli nani ni mwe na komiti ya mulimo yenu. Isuleni Lipoti ya Mulimo wa Kushimikila ya mweshi, salenipo inshila ukufuma pa lyashi lya panshi ilya pa mulu wa bati ya Tuma, elyo mutinike Tuma. Kuti mwakopolola amashiwi ayapelenganya, ukuyatuma, nelyo ukuyatuma bwangu ku Hourglass nelyo NW Publisher, iyisula na maawala yenu, Credit, ne masambililo ya Baibolo ayalembwa pa kuti mubebete no kutuma. NW Publisher ipokelela fye lipoti ya mweshi uwapita. WitnessWork ibukisha ifyo mwasala; kuti mwacinja na mu Ifyo Mwasala → Inshila ya kutuma.
faq_remainingHours_q: shani cita ine mona shani many ama-awala ine have ukumwela mweshi uno nelyo umwaka?
faq_remainingHours_a: Isuleni tab ya Ukwenda Pantanshi pa panshi. Icilangililo ca Mweshi cilanga inshita mwabomba ne maawala ayashala pa mweshi uno. Bapainia kuti bacinja ku cilangililo ca Mwaka pa kumona ifyo baleya pa co bapanga ukufikapo mu mwaka, inshita babomba, amaawala ayashala, ne fyalembwa fya cila mweshi ifilinganya amaawala ya cine na yapangilwe.
faq_goalPacing_q: shani kuti ine tell nga I'm kuntanshi nelyo kunuma pa yandi awala ico mwapanga ukufikapo?
faq_goalPacing_a: Isuleni cipao ca Ukukula ukufuma pa bati ya panshi. Icipao ca panshi ica Mweshi cilanga ico mulefwaya ukufikapo cila bushiku pa kuti mumone nga muleya bwino mu mweshi uno. Abapainiya kuti bacinja ku cipao ca Mwaka, uko ncati ya Ifyo Mulekula mu Mwaka wa Mulimo ilanga ifyo mwapita pa kuntanshi nelyo ukulwa panuma ya Ico Mwapanga ukufikapo mu Mwaka lelo, kabili umulongo wa cila mweshi ulanga ifyo umweshi uyo waleya pa co mwapanga.
faq_serviceYearPace_q: Bushe ningabelenga shani ncati ya Ifyo Mulekula mu Mwaka wa Mulimo?
faq_serviceYearPace_a: Isuleni cipao ca Ukukula no kucinja ku Mwaka. Nga umusango wenu ukwata Ico Mwapanga ukufikapo mu Mwaka, nga painiya wa nshita yonse, kadi ya Ifyo Mulekula mu Mwaka wa Mulimo yamoneka panshi ya fipimo fyenu. Umulongo wa kasaka uwakata wa buwaya ulanga uko Ico Mwapanga ukufikapo mu Mwaka cimwikata pa mpela ya cila mweshi. Upangwa ukufuma ku co mwapanga ica mweshi onse, ico ukusala mu mwaka nelyo umweshi wa painiya wa kwafwilisha kucinja, lelo ico mwapanga ica mweshi ico mwacinja mwe bene tacicinja. Umulongo wa kasaka wa bulongwe ni nshita yenu ukufika lelo, ipendwa mu nshila imo ne Lipoti yenu ya Mulimo, pamo no mupaka wa credit wa cila mweshi. Umulongo wa kasaka wa bulongwe uwakata ulundako inshita iyo mwapanga. Umulongo uwasasamuka ni mwaka wa mulimo uwapita, ulanga ilyo mwalembamo inshita, kabili inambala pa mpela yaco ni ndambo ya mwaka uwapita. Nga umulongo wapita sana Ico Mwapanga ukufikapo mu Mwaka, incende iya pa mulu wa co mwapanga yalembwa mu cipimo cinono (logarithmic) pa kuti imyeshi ya panshi ibelengwe bwino. Tinikeni no kukakatila pa ncati, elyo mukoke munwe, pa kumona ifyo umweshi onse wapwishiwa. “Ahead of pace” ilingania inshita yenu na pa mulongo wa co mwapanga lelo. Panshi ya kadi, cila mweshi ukwata umulongo: uwakosa ku nshita yalembwa, uwasasamuka ku nshita ya credit, kabili uwakwata imilongo ku bupange, ne cishibilo pa co mwapanga ica mweshi uyo. Icisokoshi pa mulu wa myeshi cilondolola ifishibilo ifi, kabili imikoloso ya Amaawala ne vs Ico Mwapanga ilanga inambala. Cila mulongo ubomfya cipimo cimo, ico kuti mwalingania imyeshi. Nga mwakwata ukwabula Ico Mwapanga ukufikapo mu Mwaka mumona imilongo ya myeshi lelo te ncati. Nga umweshi umo ulemoneka ukuti walubana, tinikeni no kukakatila pali wene pa kucinja umusango nelyo ico mwapanga. Ncati ipangwa pa cibombelo cenu ukufuma ku fyalembwa fyenu kabili tayasabankanishiwa.
faq_timeFormat_q: kuti ine display inshita nga "1h 30m" mu nshita ya "1.5"?
faq_timeFormat_a: ee. isula ifyo mwasala → Appearance na sala yenu preferred inshita umukolwe. Both formats ni cilipo everywhere inshita ni shown.
faq_weekStart_q: kuti ine tampa umulungu pa Monday mu nshita ya Sunday?
faq_weekStart_a: ee. ifyo mwasala → Appearance lets imwe sala ica ntanshi bushiku wa umulungu. cinja cibomba uku kalenda, ubupange, na cili conse fimbi cila mulungu views.
faq_darkMode_q: Bushe kuti nasala ukubomfya icafita nelyo ulubuuto?
faq_darkMode_a: ee. isula ifyo mwasala → Appearance → ulupala Scheme na sala System, Light, nelyo Dark. cibombelo ka leka following yenu phone's setting na bomfya cimo imwe sala.
faq_appIcon_a: Ifishibilo fya app ifimbi ni cipe ca Supporter pa iOS. Isuleni Settings → Ukwilolesha → Icishibilo ca App no kusala icimbi. Ifishibilo fya app ifimbi tafyaba pa Android.
faq_reorderHome_q: kuti ine reorder cards pa yandi intendekelo icilangililo?
faq_reorderHome_a: ee. isula ifyo mwasala → intendekelo icilangililo uku langa, fisa, na reorder cards. intendekelo icilangililo ka sunga yenu ifyo mwasala layout going kuntanshi.
faq_reorderTabs_q: Bushe kuti nacinja inshila ya fipao?
faq_reorderTabs_a: Ee. Isuleni Settings → Ifyo Mwasala → Inshila ya Ifipao no kubomfya imyampi ya pa mulu na panshi pa mbali ya cila cipao, nelyo ukutinika no kukakatila pa shina lya cipao pa kucisenda pa mulu nelyo panshi. Inshila ipya ibomfiwa bwangu pa bati ya panshi pa mafoni ne cipao ca mbali pa ma tablet, pa iOS na Android. Ifipao kuti fyasendwa lelo tafifishiwa. WitnessWork icili yisula pa Pa Ntanshi, kabili Ukukula kumoneka fye ku misango iilemba amaawala; kusunga ncende yakwe nga mwacinja umusango. Pa iPad, ifya kwangu fya Command-nambala fikonka inshila yenu nafyo. Inshila ni cisonto, ico yaba mu ma backup kabili ilalunganikanya na iCloud nga ukulunganikanya kwawashiwa; tayacinja ifyalembwa fyenu. Pa kubwelela, sendeni ifipao nakabili ku Pa Ntanshi, Abantu ba Kulanshanya, Ukukula, Ukupanga. Nga inshila taikushiwe, tendekeni app nakabili no kubomfya Still need help? panshi.
faq_timerRounding_q: mulandu nshi cali yandi timer rounded uku nearest 5 imineti?
faq_timerRounding_a: ico cali icikale behavior. ica nomba versions sunga cacine stopwatch inshita ilyo imwe leka timer, na no rounding. nga muli nomba line seeing 5-mineti rounding, lundulula cibombelo uku latest version.
faq_addNotesToTime_q: Bushe kuti nalundapo ifyebo ku calembwa ca nshita?
faq_addNotesToTime_a: ee. ilyo imwe lundapo nelyo lungika icalembwa ca nshita, kuti mwa attach akashiwi (e.g. "cart witnessing" nelyo "cut cipi"). kuti mwa na kabili tag ifyalembwa na amalupange efyo similar ifyalembwa stay grouped mu inshita yenu malipoti.
faq_specialPioneerAnnual_q: Ndi painia waibela, mulandu nshi app ilelanga ico mpanga ukufikapo mu mwaka?
faq_specialPioneerAnnual_a: Bapainia baibela tabakwata ico bapanga ukufikapo mu mwaka. Nga cenu cilemoneka, isuleni Ifyo Mwasala → Kasabankanya no kufumya ico mwapanga ukufikapo mu mwaka. Ico mwapanga ukufikapo cila mweshi cikashala, no mulongo wa mwaka pa cilangililo ca Mwaka mu tab ya Ukwenda Pantanshi ukafiswa.
faq_ldcCreditCap_q: Bushe LDC na maawala yambi ya credit yalundwa mu fyonse pamo fyandi?
faq_ldcCreditCap_a: Ee. Amaawala ya credit yalapendwa mu maawala yenu ya cila mweshi. Pa fyonse pamo fya mwaka wa mulimo, amaawala ya credit ukufika pa 55 pa mweshi yalapendwa, ukulingana ne cipimo ico ofeshi ya musambo yabika. Conse icacila pa cipimo cilashala pa cilembwa lelo tacilundwa pa fyonse pamo fya mwaka.
faq_timezoneShift_q: ka yandi ifyalembwa fya nshita nelyo ubupange shift inshiku nga ine travel pakati timezones?
faq_timezoneShift_a: No. nga wa April 2026 lundulula, cila icalembwa ca nshita na ubupange ni anchored uku ya ici kalenda ubushiku independent wa timezone, efyo traveling nelyo crossing daylight-ukusunga boundary ka te senda ifyalembwa uku calekana bushiku. Older ifyalembwa capangwa kale ico lundulula ni migrated mu nshila ya iyo ine ica ntanshi inshita imwe isula icipya version. nga imwe ever spot icalembwa pa icilubo bushiku panuma ukulungulula, mukwai tuma ubupusano lipoti na tuka senda mona.
faq_scheduleViews_q: Bushe ningapanga shani pa myeshi iingi nelyo ukumona umwaka onse wa mulimo?
faq_scheduleViews_a: Icipao ca Ukupanga cikwata ifilanga fibili; cinjeni pakati kabili ukubomfya bati pa mulu. Umweshi ulanga imilungu yenu nge kalenda imo iyo mupitamo ukwabula ukwima pa mpela ya mweshi, ico kuti mwapanga uno mweshi no mukonkapo pamo. Umweshi uo mulebelenga wasala wa lubuuto kabili iyi yambi ilekufya, kabili makadi yabili ayali pa mulu wa kalenda yalanga ico mwapanga ica mweshi uyo na mukonkapo: inshita yalembwa, inshita yapangwa, ne yashala ukupanga. Tinikeni kadi pa kusendeshako ku mweshi waco, nelyo mutinike iya lubuuto pa kumona ukufika ku co mwapanga, ukuya kwa bupange, na Assistant. Cila bushiku bulanga inshita mwapanga, nelyo inshita mwalemba ilyo mwalemba. Tinikeni bushiku pa kubumona nelyo ukubucinja, nelyo mutinike no kukakatila pa kulundako inshita nelyo ukubupanga. Umwaka ulanga imyeshi ikumi na ibili iya mwaka wa mulimo (September ukufika August), cila bushiku bwalembwa mu mutundu umo ne kalenda, pamo na co mwapanga ica mwaka pa mulu nga mukwata. Tinikeni umweshi, nelyo mukushe minwe, pa kuupalamina; mwisha minwe mukati mu Mweshi pa kubwelela. Umulongo uwakwata ishina ulanga uko umwaka umo wapwa kabili ukonkapo utendeka; tinikeni pa kumona umwaka uyo. Bomfyeni imyampi nelyo mukoke pa kucinja imyaka, no kutinika Lelo pa kubwelela. Ifilanga fyonse fibili fialanga fye ifili mu fyalembwa fyenu; ukucinja ifilanga tekusabankanya icintu.
faq_planDetails_q: Bushe ipepala lya Bupange likwata finshi, kabili ningacinja shani Ubupange?
faq_planDetails_a: Tinikeni bushiku pa cipao ca Ukupanga, elyo mutinike pa Bupange bumo bwabo, nelyo mutinike Ubupange pa Pa Ntanshi, pa kubwisula. Ipepala lyabo lilanga ubushiku, inshita yatendeka no kupwa (ne bushiku ubukonkapo nga bwapita pa pakati ka bushiku) nelyo Inshita Iili Yonse pa Bupange ubutakwata nshita, inshita iyo bumbila, Umusango waco, ifyo bucitwa nakabili, incende, ne lembo; tinikeni pa ncende pa kuyisula mu Maps. Pa kucinja Ubupange, tinikeni Lungika (pensulo). Pa bupange ubucitwa nakabili, ukusunga kupusha nga ukucinja kwa bushiku ubu fye, ubu ne bukonkapo, nelyo bonse. Na fimbi (•••) ikwata Kopolola Ubupange, Lemba nge Nshita (pa lelo nelyo pa kale), Isula mu Maps, Kopolola Adiresi, Kopolola Ilembo, ne Fumyapo. Na Buddies, ipepala lilondolola na abo mwaita no kwasuka kwa cila muntu, pamo na bonse abapempa ukuiba pamo, na Ita. Tinikeni Itaneni Banyina pa kwita umuntu bwangu ilyo Ubupange bucili pa kuntanshi; bapokelela ubushiku, inshita, umutwe, incende ne ilembo. Pa kufumyapo umuntu, bomfyeni Lungika. Pa Bupange mwaiba ukupitila mu kwita kwa munyina, ipepala lilanga uwabupangile no kwasuka kwenu. Cinjeni pakati ka Naya na Tentwishi Ukuya inshita iili yonse ukufika pa bushiku ubukonkapo Ubupange: Tentwishi Ukuya ifumya Ubupange ku kupanga kwenu, kabili Naya ibubwesha.
faq_editRecurringPlan_q: kuti ine lungika nelyo fumyapo single occurrence wa ubupange ububwekeshapo?
faq_editRecurringPlan_a: Ee. Pa cipao ca Ukupanga, tinikeni bushiku, elyo mutinike pa bupange pa kubwisula. Pa kucinja ubushiku ubo fye, tinikeni Lungika (pensulo), cinjeni, sungeni, elyo musale Ubushiku ubu fye. Ukucinja Umusango, umutwe, nelyo incende ya bushiku bumo kuipanga ubupange bwa umuku umo bwene. Pa kufumyapo ubushiku ubo fye, tinikeni Na fimbi (•••), elyo Fumyapo → Fumyapo Ubupange Ubu. Ubupange bwenu ubucitwa nakabili busala ifyo fine pa nshiku shimbi shonse.
faq_awayDay_q: shani cita ine mark bushiku I'm te going panse ukwabula breaking yandi ubupange ububwekeshapo?
faq_awayDay_a: Tinikeni ubupange pa bushiku ubo mu cipao ca Ukupanga pa kubwisula, tinikeni Na fimbi (•••), elyo Fumyapo → Fumyapo Ubupange Ubu. Citeni ici pa cila bupange pa bushiku ubo. Ubushiku ubo fye bufumyapo, kabili ubupange ubucitwa nakabili buleya ukufuma pa bushiku ubukonkapo. Pa kuya mu mulimo pa nshita imbi pa bushiku ubo, tinikeni Lungika, cinjeni, elyo musale Ubushiku ubu fye ilyo mulesunga.
faq_multiplePlansOneDay_q: Bushe kuti napanga ifintu ifingi pa bushiku bumo?
faq_multiplePlansOneDay_a: Ee. Ubushiku bumo kuti bwakwata ubupange bwingi nga fyo mulefwaya, ubwa umuku umo, ubucitwa nakabili, nelyo fyonse fibili, nga umulimo wa kushimikila cila Palitaano ku kasuba ne sambililo lya Baibolo cila Palitaano ilyo kwabuka. Cila bupange pa bushiku bulundwa: inshita yapangwa ya bushiku pa kalenda ya Ukupanga, inshita yashala ukupanga, ne bunga bwenu bwa kuntanshi fyonse fipenda cila cimo. Pa kulundako ubupange bumbi, tinikeni ubushiku pa cipao ca Ukupanga, elyo mutinike + pa mbali ya Ubupange. Pa kuleka ubupange ubucitwa nakabili pa bushiku bumo, bwisuleni, tinikeni Na fimbi (•••), elyo Fumyapo → Fumyapo Ubupange Ubu; inshiku shenu shimbi shisala ifyo fine. Pa kucinja pa bushiku bumo fye, tinikeni Lungika no kusala Ubushiku ubu fye ilyo mulesunga. Ubupange bwa umuku umo bwalecinja ubupange ubucitwa nakabili ubwa bushiku. Ilyo mwakushe, inshiku apo ici cacitike shabikwa ukuleka ubupange ubucitwa nakabili, ico ubunga bwenu tabwacinja. Nga ubushiku bulanga inshita ishingi ukucila ifyo mwasubila, bututinikeni no kufumyapo ubupange mushafwaya. Ubupange busala pa cibombelo cenu, bulalunganikanya na iCloud Sync nga mwaiwasha, kabili ubushiku, inshita, ne nshita iyo bumbila fye e fisabankanishiwa na banyina benu nga mulebomfya Buddies.
faq_planJustHours_q: Bushe kuti napanga amaawala ukwabula ukusala inshita?
faq_planJustHours_a: Ee. Pa foomu ya Bupange, tinikeni bati ya Inshita ishinga? pa mbali ya bushiku. Salenipo Amaawala fye pa kupanga amaawala ya bushiku ubo ukwabula inshita, nelyo Ukutendeka no kupwa pa kusala inshita iyo mutendekela no kupwila; amaawala yalundwa kuli imwe. Ubupange ubupya bwisuka nga fyo mwabomfeshe pa kulekelesha, ico inshila yenu ya bulesa yaba pa ntanshi inshita imbi. Ubupange bwa Amaawala fye bulanga Inshita Iili Yonse pa Kupanga kwenu kabili bupendwa ku co mwapanga nge bupange bumbi. Nga Nkumbushe yawashiwa, ilamukumbusha pa 8:00 AM pa bushiku ubo mu cifulo ca ntanshi ya nshita ya kutendeka. Banyina mwaita bamona ubushiku ne nshita iyo bumbila, ukwabula inshita. Pa kubupela inshita pa numa, lungikeni Ubupange no kucinja ku Ukutendeka no kupwa. Nga cibombelo cimbi cenu cicili cibomfya version iyakale iya WitnessWork, cilanga Ubupange pa kasuba mpanga ukufika cikushiwa.
faq_planFirstMonth_q: Bushe WitnessWork kuti yamupangila umweshi wenu?
faq_planFirstMonth_a: Ee. Ilyo mulepanga, nga mulemba amaawala kabili mukwete ico mwapanga ica mweshi, mupokelela ukumona bwangu kwa Assistant: saleni inshiku mwaya mu mulimo kabili ilasabankanya ico mwapanga pa nshiku shene ishi mu mweshi uno, nelyo umweshi ukonkapo nga inshiku shashala shili panshi ya cinaka. Tinikeni bushiku bwonse pa kucinja ubupange bwabo ne slider, nelyo ukupanga ubushiku mwe bene. Tinikeni Lundapo ku kupanga kwandi pa kubusunga nge bupange pa cipao ca Ukupanga, uko kuti mwacinja nelyo ukufumyapo cila bupange, nelyo mutinike Nkapanga pa numa pa kuleya ukwabula ubupange. Inshiku sha mulungu isho mwatasalile shaba inshiku sha kupola, ico Assistant tayalemusuminisha ubupange pa shene; cinjeni ici inshita iili yonse mu Settings → Ifyo Mwasala → Ubupange → Ukuba na Inshita. Panuma ya kupanga, mupanga pa cipao ca Ukupanga ukutinika bushiku bonse, kabili Assistant uko isuminisha ubupange lyonse nga mwabula ukufika ku co mwapanga. Ubupange busungwa pamo ne fyalembwa fyenu ifimbi kabili tabupendwa ku lipoti yenu; lembeni inshita iyo mwabomfya. Abakabilisha ba Bufumu abatalemba amaawala, na bonse abatakwete co mwapanga ica mweshi, babula ici, lelo kuti balundako ubupange ukufuma pa cipao ca Ukupanga.
faq_importContacts_q: kuti ine kuleta ifyebo abantu ba kutandalila ukufuma yandi phone's adiresi book?
faq_importContacts_a: Te pa nshita ino. Abantu ba kulanshanya balembwa ku maboko muli WitnessWork. Ici cilenga abantu benu ba mu mulimo wa kushimikila basungwe inkama kabili cilecefya ukuleta abantu benu bambi mu kupumfyanya.
faq_importOtherApps_q: Bushe kuti naleta ifyebo ukufuma mu MyTime, Ministry Assistant, nelyo app imbi?
faq_importOtherApps_a: Amabackup ya MyTime yasuminishiwa. Isuleni Settings → Ukuleta kwa MyTime, salenipo backup ya ntanshi iya .mytimedb ukufuma ku MyTime, elyo mubebete ukumona kuntanshi ilyo mushilaleta. Ifyo amabackup ya ma app yambi tafyasuminishiwa bwangu. Nga kuti mwatuma amalembo ayangabelengwa, Ukuleta Amalembo kuti kwamwafwa ukuleta ifyo na Scribe AI pa fibombelo ifisuminishiwa nga yaliko. Bebeteni ifyalembwa ifyasuminishiwa ne fyo ilelondolola pa ntanshi ya kusunga. Amabackup ya WitnessWork aya JSON yaba mu Settings → Ukusunga no Kubwesha.
faq_backupRestore_q: Bushe kuti nasunga no kubwesha ifyebo fyandi shani?
faq_backupRestore_a: Isuleni Settings → Ukusunga no Kubwesha → Panga Backup nelyo Bwesha ukufuma ku Backup pa kutuma nelyo ukubwesha backup ya JSON pa iOS nelyo Android. Pa cibombelo cipya, kuti mwasala na Ukufuma ku failo ya kusunga pa cipao ca kupanga ica “Tendekeni uko mwaleka”; ukubwesha kuko kupwisha ukupanga na profile yenu iyabweshiwa. Amabackup yakwata ifyalembwa fya mulimo, ubupange, abantu ba kulanshanya, intandalilo, amacipande, profile, ne fyo mwasala ifya kusabankanya. Ukubwesha kucinja ifyebo fya pa cibombelo ifyashilwamo; amabackup ya kale kuti yabula amacipande nelyo profile, ifyo fisala ifyo fine. Icishibilo ca cibombelo, ifyo mwasala fya iCloud nelyo Google Drive sync, data protection mode, ukusuminisha analytics, ne fyo mwapita mu onboarding fisala pa cibombelo ici. Ifikope tafikwatwa mu mabackup ya JSON. Pa fikope fya iCloud pa iOS, washeni ukulunganikanya ifikope mu nshila yekala. Sungeni backup ya nomba ilyo mushilabwesha kabili ibikeni pa ncende ya cinkama; ingakwata ifyebo fya bene ng'anda. Bomfyeni intambo ya Pa Kwafwilisha iya kwafwa mu cinkama pa kupokelela ukwafwa.
faq_shareAddress_q: shani cita ine poka inshila uku uwa kutandalila?
faq_shareAddress_a: isula uwa kutandalila na tinikeni yabo adiresi. muka ba offered Apple Maps, Google Maps, nelyo Waze depending pa what's installed. kuti mwa na kabili icishibilo ca pa mapu contact's uko muli ukwabula adiresi, ico ni useful pa lwa areas uko street numbers don't exist.
faq_manualPin_q: yandi icishibilo ca pa mapu ni mu icilubo place. kuti ine senda ici?
faq_manualPin_a: ee. isula contact's adiresi icilangililo na kokoleni icishibilo ca pa mapu uku correct spot. kuti mwa na kabili place icishibilo ca pa mapu ukwabula adiresi pa fyonse, ico ni helpful mu areas ukwabula precise geolocation ifyebo.
faq_profilePic_q: kuti ine lundapo icikope uku uwa kutandalila?
faq_profilePic_a: ee. isula uwa kutandalila, tinikeni avatar, na sala icikope ukufuma yenu library nelyo senda icipya cimo. ici ni especially handy ilyo abantu ba kutandalila akanya names nelyo ilyo icikope helps imwe spot ukulyo door.
faq_dismissContact_q: shani cita ine fisa uwa kutandalila ukwabula ukufumyapo bo?
faq_dismissContact_a: Isuleni umuntu wa kulanshanya elyo mutinike “Fumyapo.” Mukasala inshita ishinga ya kumufumyapo (mulungu 1, umweshi 1, imyeshi 3, imyeshi 6, nelyo umwaka 1). Umuntu wa kulanshanya afumapo ku malyashi yenu yabomba pa nshita iyo elyo abwela bwangu ilyo inshita yapwa. Nga ifyakwishibisha fyawashiwa, mukapokelela na ukukumbusha ilyo abwela, ico abantu ba kulanshanya abafumyapo tabakaluba. Kuti mwasanga nelyo ukubwesha abantu ba kulanshanya abafumyapo inshita iili yonse ukufuma pa link pa mpela ya lyashi lya Abantu ba Kulanshanya, menyu ya ••• mu Abantu ba Kulanshanya, nelyo Settings → Abantu ba Kulanshanya Abafumyapo.
faq_contactStalenessFilter_q: Bushe ningamona shani abantu ba kulanshanya abafwile ukutandalilwa?
faq_contactStalenessFilter_a: Panshi ya cifulo ca kufwaya mu Abantu ba Kulanshanya, tinikeni cishibilo pa kulanga fye abantu ba kulanshanya mu cipande ico: Abaleluba, Uno mweshi, Uno mulungu, nelyo Tamwalanshanya nabo. Cila cishibilo cilanga ukuti abantu ba kulanshanya bashingi shinga abakacilamo, kabili umutundu waco ulingana ne cishibilo ca pa mapu. Kokoleni ifishibilo ku mbali pa kumona fyonse. Tinikeni cishibilo nakabili, nelyo Fyonse, pa kulanga bonse. Ifishibilo fimo fyaba pa mulu wa mapu, uko fyapenda fye abantu ba kulanshanya abakwete incende kabili fyasefya ifishibilo; fyafisamo ilyo mulesenda mapu, ico tinikeni umutwe wa Abantu ba Kulanshanya pa kubibwesha. Pa kucinja inshila yafyo, tinikeni cishibilo, mwimeko panono, elyo mukokole pa mulongo; Fyonse cisala ca ntanshi. Inshila ni cisonto, ico yaba mu mabackup kabili ilalunganikanya na iCloud Sync pa iOS. Ifipande fikonka ulutandalilo lwenu lwa nomba line, kabili “Taali pa ng'anda” lupendwa nge ntandalilo. Pa kucinja inshita umuntu wa kulanshanya aya ukufuma pa cipande ukuya pa cimbi, nelyo imitundu, tinikeni bati ya ifyebo pa mpela ya fishibilo (pa mapu, bati ya cilangililo) elyo pensulo. Cishibilo cilundako cisonto ico kuti mwamona no kufumyapo mu Sala & Sefya, kabili cibomba pa lyashi na pa mapu fyonse. Abantu ba kulanshanya abafumyapo tabapendwa. Tapali icasabankanishiwa; ifipande fipangwa pa cibombelo cenu.
faq_reportBug_q: shani cita ine lipoti ubupusano nelyo request icibomfya?
faq_reportBug_a: Bomfyeni ifibatani ifyapanshi pa kutuma ubwafya bwa app nelyo ukupempa icipya. Lundeni ifyo mwacita pa kuleta ubwafya, ifyo mwasubile, icibombelo cenu ne version ya operating system, ne version ya WitnessWork iyo mulemona pa Still need help?. Fumyeni ifyebo fya bantu ba kulanshanya, amalembo, ama ID ya akaunti, na Buddies Codes nelyo ama link ya kwita mu malipoti ya bantu bonse na fikope. Pa bwafya bwa backup nelyo ubwafya bumbi ubwa cinkama, bomfyeni link ya email ya cinkama mu Still need help?. Source code, Ifunde lya Cinkama, na Fya Kubomfya fyaba mu Settings → Pa Mulandu.
faq_translations_q: Bushe WitnessWork isuminisha indimi shinshi, kabili ningatuma shani ukupilibula ukwabula?
faq_translations_a: WitnessWork yaba mu ndimi 18. Ikonka ululimi lwa cibombelo cenu mu kutendeka; pa kusala ulumbi, isuleni Settings no kucinja Ululimi. Nga ululimi lwenu talusuminishiwa, app ilanga Cingeleshi. Amapilibula yapangwa na AI, ico ilyashi nelyo icisabo kuti cabula ukuya bwino, ukucilisha amashiwi Inte sha kwa Yehova shibomfya mu nshila yekala. Pa kutuma, bomfyeni link ya email mu Still need help? no kulundako ululimi lwenu, icipao, amalembo yo mumona, ne fyo cifwile ukulanda. Icikope cilafwa; funikeni amashina, adiresi, na malembo pa ntanshi. Ukwalula kwisa mu kukusha kwa app ukukonkapo. Takwaba nakabili pulojekiti ya bakalume ya kupilibula iyo mwingaiba.
faq_becomeSupporter_a: Ukulipila kwa Supporter ukubomba kumupela icishibilo ca Supporter, imitundu ya cisonto, ifilanga fya bantu ba kulanshanya ifyasungwa, na Pangeni Inshila ya Lelo, iyabika ukukonkapo na bupange bwa bushiku mu nshila iyipi iya kwendamo, pamo na iCloud Sync ne fishibilo fya app ifimbi pa iOS na Google Drive Sync pa Android. Aba Supporter nabo bapokelela ukubomfya Scribe AI ukucila pa Kuleta Amalembo pa iOS na Android uko yaba; ukubomfya kwa bwebwe ne kwa Supporter kwa nomba kumoneka mu Ukwafwa no pa cipao ca kwafwa. Ifintu fikalamba filesha ukuba fya bwebwe, pamo ne fisonto na kusala kwa bantu ba kulanshanya, na Buddies nga yaliko; aba Supporter kuti basala na mutundu wa cila munyina. Tip ya umuku umo ipela Donor ukwishibikwa lelo tayawasha ifyo Supporter akwata.
faq_stillFree_q: ni WitnessWork nomba line ya uluse?
faq_stillFree_a: ee — na inshita yonse cika. cila core icibomfya stays ya uluse pa lwa onse. Supporting ni completely nga mulefwaya; ici helps fund ongoing development na unlocks few ica imwe touches nga natotela-imwe.
faq_stopSupporting_q: finshi happens nga ine leka supporting?
faq_stopSupporting_a: Pa kuleka, isuleni Settings → Longolokeni ukulipila no kusala Leka nelyo cinja ukulipila, nelyo mulekeko mu kulipila kwenu kwa App Store nelyo Google Play. Ukufika kwa Supporter kuleya ukufika ku mpela ya nshita iyo mwalipila, kabili ifyebo fyenu ifyaliko ne mabackup ya pa cibombelo fisala. Panuma ya ico, iCloud sync yaleka ilyo ukufika kwa Supporter tekuliko. Nga ukulunganikanya kwawashiwa, kutendeka nakabili ilyo ukufika kwabwela; ukusala ukushimya kwenu kusala kushimiwa. Ukulunganikanya ifikope kukonka ifyo mwasala fyacene. Umutundu wenu ne cishibilo ca app fibwelela ku fya bulesa, lelo ifyo mwasala fisungwa ilyo mwakwafwa nakabili. Ifilanga fya bantu ba kulanshanya ifyasungwa fifisiwa kabili tafibomfiwa nakabili, ico Abantu ba Kulanshanya balanga ifisonto fyenu fene; fibwela ilyo mwakwafwa nakabili. Moneni Settings → iCloud Sync pa kumona ifyo ilanga nomba. Nga mufwaya fye ukupola, kuti mwaleka ukulipila mu cifulo.
faq_pauseSupport_q: Bushe kuti naleka ukwafwa mu cifulo ca kuleka bwino?
faq_pauseSupport_a: Ee. Isuleni Settings → Longolokeni ukulipila. Pa iPhone na iPad, salenipo ukuleka ukulipila umweshi 1, 3, nelyo 6. Ukuleka kutendeka ilyo inshita yenu ya nomba ipwa. Tamukalipishiwa ilyo mwaleka, kabili ifyo Supporter akwata fisala, pamo na iCloud Sync, umutundu wenu, ne cishibilo ca app. Ukulipila kutendeka nakabili bwangu na mutengo umo pa bushiku ubulangwa, kabili kuti mwaleka inshita iili yonse mu kulipila kwenu kwa App Store. Kuti mwaleka umuku umo pa myeshi 12; inshiku sha kuleka shisungwa pamo ne fyo mwasala ico ifibombelo fyenu ifimbi fishikonka. Pa Android, salenipo Leka muli Google Play pa kuleka ukulipila kwa cila mweshi umweshi 1 ukufika pa myeshi 3. Ifyo Supporter akwata nga icishibilo ne mutundu fileka nafyo, elyo fyabwelela bwangu ne fyo mwasala fisungwa, kabili kuti mwabwelela bwangu muli Google Play. Ifyo mwingasala pa kuleka tafimoneka ilyo muli mu kwesha kwa bwebwe, ubwafya bwa kulipila, ukulipila kwa Family Sharing, nelyo mu myeshi 12 iya kuleka kwa kulekelesha. Nga ukuleka kwabula, tapali icacinja; esheniko nakabili pa numa nelyo mulongoloke ukulipila kwenu mu stoo yenu. Pa fimbi, bomfyeni Still need help? pa kwebako abafwa mu cinkama.
faq_acceptDonations_q: mulandu nshi ni imwe accepting ifya bupe?
faq_acceptDonations_a: Nga munyinefwe mu Ng'anda ya Bufumu, mmona kwati ni nsansa ukubomfya amano yandi pa kwafwilisha bambi mu cilonganino. Nangu ca kuti app iyi ya kubula ukulipila kuli bonse, ukuipanga, ukuibomfya no kuisunga kulafwaya indalama ishingi ne nshita iikalamba. Mmona ukupeela indalama kwati ni filya umo engalipilila peleto wa munankwe panuma ya kuya mu mulimo na wene - kucita kwa kutemwa uko batasha nga nshi.
faq_donationsUsedFor_q: finshi ni ifya bupe cabomfiwa pa lwa?
faq_donationsUsedFor_a: yenu ca bupe helps keeps ici cibombelo running! uko ni costs na purchasing real ifibombelo nga development equipment, paying pa lwa uko muli API umulimo fees, build umulimo API fees, cibombelo store fees, na opportunity cost wa yandi many ama-awala spent developing ici cibombelo. cila piece wa ukwafwilisha ni greatly appreciated!
faq_whatsNew_q: uko kuti ine mona finshi cacinja mu latest lundulula?
faq_findNavigation_q: Bushe Mapu, Buddies, na Settings fili kwi?
faq_findNavigation_a: Bati ya panshi ilanga Pa Ntanshi, Ukupanga, Abantu ba Kulanshanya, na Ukukula, na Lundapo pa mbali yafyo pa kulemba inshita, ukupanga Ubupange, nelyo ukulundako umuntu wa kulanshanya. Ukukula na Lundapo Inshita fimoneka ilyo umusango wenu ulemba amaawala. Mapu yaba mu Abantu ba Kulanshanya: tinikeni bati ya mapu pa mbali ya mutwe wa Abantu ba Kulanshanya, kabili WitnessWork isula icilanga ico mwabomfeshe pa kulekelesha. Buddies, nga yaliko pa iOS, yisulwa ukufuma pa bati ya Buddies pa mulu wa Ukupanga. Mona Lipoti pa mulu wa Ukukula yisula Lipoti ya Mulimo ya mweshi uo mulemona.
